page_title: VER 1-2 NAP | Verona v Napoli 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Andrea Colombo has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90+6' 1 - 2 Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
90+5' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post.
90+3' Martin Frese (Verona) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+1' Tomas Suslov (Verona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' It seemed like Tomas Suslov (Verona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Juan Jesus (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
89' 35:65 – the latest ball possession ratio.
86' A long pass finds Giovane (Napoli) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
84' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
83' Here is a change. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro is going off and Paolo Sammarco gives the last tactical orders to Cheikh Niasse (Verona).
82' Substitution. Tobias Slotsager (Verona) has come on for Abdou Harroui.
82' Abdou Harroui (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

80' A pass travels right across the box to Eljif Elmas (Napoli) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo denies him with a decent save.
78' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Matteo Politano will be replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Antonio Vergara as he is replaced by Giovane (Napoli).
75' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
73' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Stanislav Lobotka and he is replaced by Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alisson Santos departs the field of play to be replaced by Romelu Lukaku (Napoli).
72' Good work from Verona as they win a corner.
72' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
70' Paolo Sammarco is forced to make a change. Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Tomas Suslov.
69' Antonio Conte (Napoli) gets a yellow card, off the field.
68' Napoli get a corner.
67' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Andrea Colombo signals that the goal stands! The Verona players celebrate.
66' The Verona players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
65' 1 - 1 Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) gets to the rebound and sends it goalwards, surprising the goalkeeper, who watches the ball go into the back of the net.
64' Verona will take a corner kick.
60' Paolo Sammarco isn't happy on the touchline after referee Andrea Colombo shows him a yellow card.

60' Abdou Harroui (Verona) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
59' Shots on target – 1:3.
56' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
55' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) is substituted due to injury. Paolo Sammarco gives a chance to Martin Frese.
55' Paolo Sammarco prepares a substitution. Amin Sarr is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
53' Verona are ruled offside.
52' Here comes a substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola is given a rest as he is replaced by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli).
50' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
50' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Andrea Colombo interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
48' Napoli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Napoli win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
42' The game is interrupted as Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is flagged offside.
40' Kieron Bowie (Verona) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
39' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:3.
38' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Matteo Politano (Napoli).
37' What a great touch by Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
34' Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
34' Napoli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
31' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Napoli was in an offside position.
26' Verona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

23' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Lorenzo Montipo, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
22' Abdou Harroui (Verona) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post.
21' The ball possession is 43:57.
20' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
18' Amin Sarr (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' Wonderful movement by Napoli. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
13' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' That's a well-taken pass by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
8' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
8' Alisson Santos (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

6' Andrea Colombo blows for a foul after Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Napoli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
3' 0 - 1 Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is quickest to the rebound inside the penalty area, and he plants a header directly inside the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Napoli will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo will officiate today.
